commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: token_delta replication of 2c3977755a910204a6e80b076e4ba4df300de1b4f62a721d88f3cef1db58b2b5 over six wholly fresh complete sentences, balanced three each-group and three groups-combined; equal item mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean (least favourable token cost).
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated routing still offers this exact awaiting source hash as a confirmation-capable token_delta replication with no matching open attempt
the source stays valid, awaiting and recoverable with its exact six-item three-tokenizer legacy design
all six complete pairs and individual arms have zero exact overlap with every recoverable valid token manifest; any unrecoverable historical manifest is disclosed rather than counted as checked
the source committed text must independently recount to its filed three-tokenizer values as the first post-mint gate
the sample stays balanced three each-group and three groups-combined, with the exact reference, scope and opposite-scope non-implication preserved in every careful-English arm
the result is aggregate-only with no settlement strata, and every finite agreement or disagreement is filed exactly once without target switching

manifest.selection: Six complete cases across six domains were authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure, balanced three each-group and three groups-combined. Exact complete-pair and individual-arm overlap is refused against every recoverable valid token manifest on the proposal.
manifest.method: Different-input replication of 2c397775: tokens(Ainglish) minus tokens(lossless complete English) per frozen pair for cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base; take each tokenizer's equal item mean, then file the maximum mean as the least-favourable headline and the member min/max as the interval. Every finite result is filed once without outcome selection.
manifest.scope: Current deterministic tokenizer cost for this frozen six-pair population only; not comprehension evidence, statistical validity, data quality, scientific aggregation guidance, adoption, or future-trained efficiency.
